en.title: The Global Series opens in Helsinki with Aho and the champions as heavy favourites
en.deck: The NHL Global Series opens at Veikkaus Arena in Helsinki, and Carolina's Finns, led by Sebastian Aho, are back home. The defending champions are 14-3-2 and have won six of seven. Seattle is 9-6-1 and has dropped out of a wild-card spot. The market makes Carolina a clear favourite, and the model is a bit less sure.
news: It is Game 1 of two in Helsinki; the same teams play again Saturday. Seattle is the home team in Finland's largest indoor arena.

Hurricanes: captain Jordan Staal (calf, hurt in warmups Oct. 11) has practised on the trip but is not expected to play until Saturday at the earliest. William Carrier is day-to-day with a knee injury.

Kraken: Jared McCann is out about 10 weeks with a lower-body injury, and Ryan Lindgren, Jake O'Brien and Curtis Douglas are also out. Joey Daccord was pulled Saturday after allowing three goals on 10 shots in a 4-3 loss to the Rangers.
Pyotr Kochetkov (11-1-0, .920) is the likely Carolina starter. Seattle's goalie is not confirmed.
records: Taylor Hall is set to play his 1,000th NHL game.
Jackson Blake has a nine-game point streak, a career best. For Seattle, Berkly Catton leads with 14 points and has points in eight straight games.
Carolina beat Chicago 9-2 on Saturday and shares the league lead with 30 points. Aho leads the team with 26.
Seattle's penalty kill ranks 31st at 65.1 %. Carolina's is seventh at 85 %. Thirteen of the Kraken's 16 games have gone over 5.5 goals.
betting: Market: Hurricanes 1.33, Kraken 3.45, about 72–28 without the margin. The model has Carolina at 65 %, so it gives Seattle more of a chance than the market does.
Total: the market prices over 5.5 at 1.57 (about 60 %), and the model agrees at 58 %. At 6.5 the market is near 50 % and the model says 47 %. The last six meetings averaged 5.8 goals.

Player chances (model): Aho 1+ point 67 % and goal 35 %. Matty Beniers 1+ point 40 % (market about 43 %). Brandon Montour 1+ point 41 % against about 35 % in the market, one of the few spots where the model is warmer on a Kraken player.

sv.title: Global Series inleds i Helsingfors med Aho och mästarna som klara favoriter
sv.deck: NHL Global Series inleds i Veikkaus Arena i Helsingfors, och Carolinas finländare med Sebastian Aho i spetsen är på hemmaplan. De regerande mästarna har 14-3-2 och har vunnit sex av sju. Seattle har 9-6-1 och har tappat sin wildcardplats. Marknaden gör Carolina till klar favorit, och modellen är lite mindre säker.
news: Det är den första av två matcher i Helsingfors, och lagen möts igen på lördag. Seattle är hemmalag i Finlands största inomhusarena.
Hurricanes: lagkaptenen Jordan Staal (vad, skadad i uppvärmningen 11 oktober) har tränat under resan men väntas spela tidigast på lördag. William Carrier är osäker med en knäskada.

Kraken: Jared McCann är borta i cirka tio veckor med en skada i underkroppen, och Ryan Lindgren, Jake O'Brien och Curtis Douglas saknas också. Joey Daccord byttes ut i lördags efter tre insläppta mål på tio skott i 3-4 mot Rangers.
Pyotr Kochetkov (11-1-0, ,920) väntas starta för Carolina. Seattles målvakt är inte bekräftad.
records: Taylor Hall väntas spela sin 1 000:e NHL-match.
Jackson Blake har poäng i nio raka matcher, hans bästa svit hittills. Hos Seattle leder Berkly Catton med 14 poäng och har gjort poäng i åtta raka.
Carolina slog Chicago med 9-2 i lördags och delar ligaledningen med 30 poäng. Aho leder laget med 26.
Seattles boxplay är 31:a i ligan med 65,1 %, Carolinas sjua med 85 %. Tretton av Krakens 16 matcher har gått över 5,5 mål.
betting: Marknaden: Hurricanes 1,33, Kraken 3,45, ungefär 72–28 utan marginal. Modellen har Carolina på 65 %, så den ger Seattle större chans än marknaden.

en.title: Unbeaten-in-regulation Canadiens meet a Bruins team on four straight wins
en.deck: Boston is 13-4-1 with a +26 goal difference and goes for a fifth straight win. Montreal has points in 11 straight games and hasn't lost in regulation since Oct. 14. It is the first meeting of the season, and the model and the market both see it as nearly even.
news: Jacob Fowler (8-1-2, .925) starts for Montreal, his third straight start. Boston's starter was not confirmed at the time of writing.

Mike Matheson (lower body) practised fully Wednesday for the first time and is travelling, but his return after six missed games is not confirmed. Ivan Demidov (fractured ankle) has been out since Oct. 3 and has no firm return date.
Montreal lost 2-1 in overtime to Minnesota on Tuesday after Cole Caufield's slashing penalty with 56 seconds left. Caufield criticised the call afterwards.
Bruins: Jeremy Swayman made 40 saves in a 4-1 win over Florida on Saturday. Forward James Hagens is out with a back injury.
records: The Canadiens are 7-0-3 in their last 10 and 5-0-0 against Atlantic Division opponents.
David Pastrnak has 24 points (8 goals, 16 assists), and Charlie McAvoy has eight assists in his last 10 games.
Caufield has a four-game point streak. Nick Suzuki leads Montreal with 16 points (7 goals, 9 assists).
Montreal has taken the second-most minor penalties in the league (85). The last 11 meetings averaged 7.0 goals.

sv.deck: Boston har 13-4-1 och +26 i målskillnad och jagar sin femte raka seger. Montreal har tagit poäng i elva raka matcher och har inte förlorat i full tid sedan 14 oktober. Det är säsongens första möte, och både modellen och marknaden ser det som nästan jämnt.
news: Jacob Fowler (8-1-2, ,925) startar för Montreal, hans tredje raka start. Bostons målvakt var inte bekräftad när detta skrevs.

Mike Matheson (underkropp) tränade fullt i onsdags för första gången och följer med, men comebacken efter sex missade matcher är inte bekräftad. Ivan Demidov (fotledsfraktur) har varit borta sedan 3 oktober och har inget fast datum för comeback.
Montreal förlorade med 1-2 efter förlängning mot Minnesota i tisdags, efter att Cole Caufield fått en utvisning för slashing 56 sekunder före slutet. Caufield kritiserade domslutet efteråt.
Bruins: Jeremy Swayman gjorde 40 räddningar i 4-1 mot Florida i lördags. Forwarden James Hagens är borta med en ryggskada.

Caufield har poäng i fyra raka. Nick Suzuki leder Montreal med 16 poäng (7 mål, 9 assist).

en.title: Winless in November, the Leafs face Kaprizov and the Central leaders
en.deck: Toronto is 8-10-2, has lost four straight and has not won in November. Minnesota is 13-3-4, leads the Central and has points in nine straight games. The model makes the Wild favourites, though a little less clearly than the market, and it expects fewer goals than the market does.
news: The Leafs lost 6-3 to Colorado on Tuesday and have allowed 17 goals in the first four games of a six-game homestand. First-year coach Jim Hiller, who replaced Craig Berube in June, said afterwards: "You can't hope. You can't be average."
Sergei Bobrovsky has an .881 save percentage and has lost five straight starts. Anthony Stolarz (5-2-0) could get the net. No starter is confirmed.
Morgan Rielly could return after missing two games. Colton Sissons is out, and Max Domi is out until late January.

Wild: Brock Faber (skull fracture) is skating but is not expected back before Saturday. Filip Gustavsson (hip) is out until at least Nov. 19. Kaprizov won Tuesday's game in Montreal 21 seconds into overtime.
records: Kirill Kaprizov has 17 goals, second in the NHL.
Quinn Hughes has 27 points (6 goals, 21 assists). He reached 80 points with Minnesota in 68 games, the second-fastest any defenceman has hit 80 with a franchise.
Minnesota allows a league-low 2.2 goals a game, and Jesper Wallstedt has a .925 save percentage.
Jack Roslovic leads Toronto with 20 points (9 goals, 11 assists).
betting: Market: Wild 1.63, Maple Leafs 2.35, about 59–41 without the margin. The model has Minnesota at 56 %, slightly closer to even.
Total: the market prices over 5.5 at 1.61 (about 59 %), and the model says 53 %. At 6.5 it is 48 % against 42 %. The model leans clearly lower, in line with Minnesota's league-best defence.
Player chances (model): Kaprizov 1+ point 72 % and goal 46 %, Hughes 1+ point 69 %, Auston Matthews 1+ point 63 %. The market is within a point or two on all three.

sv.deck: Toronto har 8-10-2, har förlorat fyra raka och har inte vunnit i november. Minnesota har 13-3-4, leder Central och har tagit poäng i nio raka. Modellen gör Wild till favoriter, om än lite mindre tydligt än marknaden, och väntar sig färre mål än marknaden.
news: Leafs förlorade med 3-6 mot Colorado i tisdags och har släppt in 17 mål på de fyra första matcherna av en hemmasvit på sex. Förstaårstränaren Jim Hiller, som ersatte Craig Berube i juni, sade efteråt att laget inte kan hoppas och inte kan vara medelmåttigt.

en.title: Ullmark is expected back as Ottawa takes on the league's top offence
en.deck: Both teams are 11-6-2. Colorado leads the NHL with 4.11 goals a game and comes in off a 6-3 win in Toronto. Ottawa expects Linus Ullmark back after nine games out. The model has it dead even, while the market leans slightly toward the Avalanche.
news: Ullmark (lower body, hurt Oct. 21) is expected to start, pending a check after the morning skate. He is 7-1-0 with a 1.33 goals-against average and a .945 save percentage. Ottawa is 4-3-2 without him.
Nick Cousins will miss 7–10 days after he was knocked out by a Jakob Chychrun hit in Tuesday's 3-2 overtime loss to Washington. Travis Green still called it "one of our better games of the year."
Avalanche: Gabriel Landeskog scored twice and Mackenzie Blackwood (10-3-1) made 28 saves in Toronto. Josh Manson (ankle) is out about eight weeks.
It is the second stop of a Canadian road trip for Colorado that ends in Montreal.
records: Artturi Lehkonen leads Colorado with 13 goals.
Ottawa's power play ranks 31st at 12.5 %.
The last six meetings averaged 8.8 goals, including an 8-2 Colorado win in Ottawa in January.
Only 9 of Ottawa's 19 games have gone over 5.5 goals, compared with 13 of 19 for Colorado.
betting: Market: Avalanche 1.84, Senators 2.02, about 52–48 without the margin. The model says 50–50.

Total: over 5.5 is priced at 1.61 (about 59 %), and the model says 54 %. At 6.5 it is 49 % against 44 %. The model is lower than the market, perhaps because of Ullmark's numbers, while the wild head-to-head history points the other way.

sv.deck: Båda lagen har 11-6-2. Colorado leder NHL med 4,11 mål per match och kommer från 6-3 i Toronto. Ottawa räknar med att Linus Ullmark är tillbaka efter nio missade matcher. Modellen ser en helt jämn match, medan marknaden lutar svagt åt Avalanche.

en.title: Ovechkin needs one assist for a Capitals record, with Hellebuyck in the other net
en.deck: Alex Ovechkin's assist on Tuesday's overtime winner in Ottawa was his 762nd, tying Nicklas Backstrom's franchise record, so his next one stands alone. He likely faces Connor Hellebuyck, who won his first five starts after his trade to New Jersey. The Devils have won 9 of 11, and the model has them as slightly smaller favourites than the market does.
news: Hellebuyck, acquired from Winnipeg last month after asking for a trade, is expected to start. He shut out Toronto 4-0 on Saturday. Jake Allen was in goal for Tuesday's 4-2 loss in Winnipeg, which ended a five-game winning streak.
Logan Thompson is expected in goal for Washington.

Devils: Anthony Mantha (neck) is out until at least Dec. 5 and Seamus Casey (knee) until at least Nov. 21. Johnathan Kovacevic is day-to-day. Capitals: Rasmus Sandin (knee) and Vincent Desharnais (abdomen) are out.
Cole Hutson scored the winner in Ottawa and has 21 points in 30 NHL games. He is the fastest defenceman in Capitals history to reach 20.
records: Ovechkin has 929 career goals and 1,692 points. He had gone 10 games without a goal before Tuesday.
Jack Hughes has a six-game point streak (5 goals, 7 assists). Nico Hischier reached 500 career points on Saturday.
Hellebuyck's five straight wins to start his Devils career are a franchise first.
It is the second half of a home-and-home; Washington won the first game 4-2 on Oct. 17. Thirteen of Washington's 16 games have gone over 5.5 goals.
betting: Market: Devils 1.62, Capitals 2.35, about 59–41 without the margin. The model has New Jersey at 56 %, a little warmer on Washington.

sv.deck: Alex Ovechkins assist på tisdagens förlängningsmål i Ottawa var hans 762:a, vilket tangerade Nicklas Bäckströms klubbrekord, så nästa assist blir ett eget rekord. Troligen möter han Connor Hellebuyck, som vann sina fem första starter efter bytet till New Jersey. Devils har vunnit 9 av 11, och modellen ser dem som något mindre favoriter än marknaden.
news: Hellebuyck, som kom från Winnipeg förra månaden efter att ha bett om en trade, väntas starta. Han höll nollan mot Toronto (4-0) i lördags. Jake Allen stod i tisdagens 2-4-förlust i Winnipeg, som bröt en svit på fem raka segrar.
Logan Thompson väntas stå för Washington.

Devils: Anthony Mantha (nacke) är borta till minst 5 december och Seamus Casey (knä) till minst 21 november. Johnathan Kovacevic är osäker. Capitals: Rasmus Sandin (knä) och Vincent Desharnais (buk) saknas.

Hellebuyck är den förste i Devils historia att vinna sina fem första matcher för klubben.

en.title: Kucherov's record hat trick sends Tampa Bay into a back-to-back in Columbus
en.deck: Tampa Bay won 8-3 in Buffalo on Wednesday, with a natural hat trick from Nikita Kucherov, and plays again 24 hours later. Columbus is 7-9-0 and 30th in scoring. The market has it as a coin flip, and the model, mindful of the back-to-back, leans slightly toward the Blue Jackets.
news: Erik Cernak went into the glass in Buffalo, and Jon Cooper said he is "probably out" Thursday. Max Crozier or Emil Lilleberg would step in. Brayden Point is on injured reserve with no timeline.
Andrei Vasilevskiy played Wednesday, so Dennis Hildeby (3-0-1) is the likely starter. Columbus would counter with Jet Greaves (2-6-0, 3.36). Neither starter is confirmed.
Blue Jackets: Columbus lost 4-1 at home to Florida on Tuesday, its second straight loss. Conor Garland (upper body) is out with no timetable.
It is Military Appreciation Night in Columbus.
records: It was Kucherov's third natural hat trick, a Lightning record, and his eighth career hat trick, tied with Martin St. Louis for second in team history.
John Carlson had a goal and four assists in Buffalo and passed 800 NHL points. Anthony Cirelli played his 600th game.
Tampa Bay scores 3.94 goals a game (fourth) and Columbus 2.44 (30th). Kent Johnson leads the Blue Jackets with 8 goals and 16 points.
The last nine meetings averaged 8.1 goals.

en.title: Reinhart one goal from 200 as Florida hosts a Red Wings team on a four-game skid
en.deck: Detroit has lost four straight and been outscored 13-5 over that stretch, while the Dylan Larkin standoff goes on. Florida snapped a two-game slide with a 4-1 win in Columbus, and Sam Reinhart's next goal will be his 200th for the club. The market makes the Panthers clear favourites; the model is noticeably warmer on Detroit.
news: Larkin was suspended without pay by the Red Wings on Oct. 29 after his agent said he would no longer play for Detroit. He has asked for a trade and has a full no-trade clause.

John Gibson returned from a lower-body injury with 30 saves in Tuesday's 3-2 loss in St. Louis, and Mason Appleton and Marco Kasper also came back. Gibson and Jacob Markstrom are the projected starters, but neither is confirmed.
Panthers: Brad Marchand (knee) said on Nov. 5 that he hopes to return in about six weeks. Captain Aleksander Barkov is hurt but nearing a return. Sandis Vilmanis is also out.
Sam Bennett scored twice and Markstrom made 37 saves in Florida's win on Tuesday.
records: Reinhart has 199 goals with Florida, second in franchise history behind Barkov (286).
Matthew Tkachuk has a five-game point streak with seven assists. Florida has scored on the power play in seven of its last eight games.
